description: This file contains the implementation of the PersonGrain class, which is an Orleans grain that manages person state with event sourcing capabilities, including methods for registering, updating, and testing state changes.

classes.name: PersonGrain
classes.description: An Orleans Grain implementing event sourcing for managing a person's state, including event registration, state updates, and internal test methods.

methods.name: RegisterBirth
methods.description: Registers a new person with their attributes if not already registered.

methods.name: Marry
methods.description: Handles marriage between the grain's person and a spouse, raising relevant events.

methods.name: ChangeLastName
methods.description: Raises an event to change the person's last name without immediate confirmation.

methods.name: ConfirmChanges
methods.description: Confirms all unconfirmed events, updating the state.

methods.name: GetTentativePersonalAttributes
methods.description: Returns the person's attributes in the tentative state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedPersonalAttributes
methods.description: Returns the person's attributes in the confirmed state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the confirmed version number of the person's state.

methods.name: GetTentativeVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative version number of the person's state.

methods.name: RunTentativeConfirmedStateTest
methods.description: A unit test method to verify the correctness of tentative and confirmed state management.
